reasons: BLIND-INTEGRITY PROBE FAILED: the judge identified the authority correctly on 10/10 probed documents (accuracy 1.00, 95% CI [0.72, 1.00], chance 0.50). Redaction did not blind it, so the favourability scores may reflect the judge's priors about the authority rather than the text. The number below is NOT a valid balance measurement. If you believe the residual signal is intrinsic rather than a redaction bug — the two authorities really are different kinds of institution writing different kinds of document — re-run with --allow-blind-leak, which keeps this warning and computes the verdict anyway.
